Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Dashboard Preferences

Daftar Role & Deskripsi

Role Name Deskripsi Default Landing Session Timeout
superadmin Akses penuh tanpa batasan untuk semua konfigurasi dan management data. /dashboard/executive 15 menit (MFA enforced)
admin Manajemen user, monitoring insiden, approval, non-critical configs, dan audit. /dashboard/admin 30 menit
noc_engineering Aktivitas teknis: monitoring live, health, RCA, fleet, dan live logs. /dashboard/monitoring 60 menit
operator Monitoring live, membuat/mengupdate insiden, ticket, dan approval request. /dashboard/operator 120 menit
viewer Hak akses baca-saja (read-only) untuk monitoring, report, dan analytics. /dashboard/viewer 240 menit

Daftar Permission Sistem

Permission Key Scope / Scope Action Deskripsi
all GLOBAL Akses penuh ke seluruh sistem tanpa limitasi.
access_config CONFIG Mengubah konfigurasi non-kritis dan setelan parameter aplikasi.
remote_access REMOTE Melakukan remote restart container / relay command ke server.
access_governance GOVERNANCE Melihat dan memproses daftar approval queue (HITL).
restart_containers INFRASTRUCTURE Mengontrol dan merestart status infrastruktur Docker.
user_management ADMINISTRATIVE Membuat, menghapus, atau mengedit akun pengguna sistem.
view_audit AUDIT Membaca aktivitas audit log keamanan sistem.
view_evidence GOVERNANCE Melihat timeline dan detail evidence di Evidence Explorer.
view_decision_record GOVERNANCE Melihat alasan dan parameter Audit Decision AI.
view_kgraph TOPOLOGY Membuka overlay dan warna node Knowledge Graph.
run_chaos_test CHAOS Menjalankan injeksi kegagalan pada production sistem.
policy_override HITL Melakukan bypass manual pada keputusan AI (HITL Override).
dlq_recovery OPERATIONS Me-requeue pesan gagal dari Dead Letter Queue ke bus NATS.

RAG Ingestion Gate
                Conditions

            

            

              
Learning is only permitted when ALL
                conditions below are satisfied. Any failure blocks ingestion and logs to audit trail.

              
 verification_status == SUCCESSREQUIRED

              
 human_confirmed == trueREQUIRED

              
 rollback_needed == falseREQUIRED


              

                 confidence >=
                
                
                
              


              
Block Conditions:
• verification FAILED or
                PARTIAL
• rollback triggered
• operator rejected resolution
• confidence below threshold
